verdict.rationale: Grok's own built-in Google Drive connector can search and read files, and connectors give it access to a user's files inside chat. That provides a first-party route to analyzing document contents, supported by a 500k-token context window. However, no evidence shows direct upload of documents, spreadsheets, or PDFs, or analysis of those formats specifically; image input is the only documented upload-style understanding. Missing for 10: documented direct file upload in chat/API, explicit PDF and spreadsheet parsing support, any evidence on analysis accuracy, independent or hands-on corroboration of file analysis.
